desc: Derive the potential formulation and pairwise geometric conflict characterization.
Correct the offline conflict-detection implementation so only previously processed people can be removed.
Validate the corrected algorithm on both public samples.
Prove that earliest-conflict/suffix-minimum boundaries answer arbitrary index-range queries.
Develop a scalable dynamic 2D range-reporting structure for crossing-interval detection.
Reassess memory, time complexity, and correctness after the new implementation.
